# Council for Accreditation in Occupational Hearing Conservation (CAOHC)

> CAOHC provides professional certification and training programs for occupational hearing conservation specialists, with a focus on OSHA compliance and audiometric testing standards.

CAOHC is the primary accrediting body for occupational hearing conservation certifications, offering multiple credential pathways including COHC (Certified Occupational Hearing Conservationist), Course Director, and other specialized roles. The organization maintains a learning center platform and comprehensive resources for professionals in occupational health and safety.

## Key Topics

- Certified Occupational Hearing Conservationist (COHC)
- Course Director (CD)
- Occupational Hearing Conservation
- OSHA Compliance
- Audiometric Testing
- Certification Requirements
- Hearing Conservation Program
- Professional Supervisor (CPS/A)
- Hearing Conservation Manager (HCM)
- CAOHC Learning Center
- Credential Verification
- Exam Preparation
- Noise Measurement
- Occupational Safety
- Recertification

## COHC Certification Program

- [Certified Occupational Hearing Conservationist (COHC)](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist): Main COHC certification program page with training and credential information.
- [About the Training](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/about-the-training): COHC training overview covering audiometric testing and OSHA compliance requirements.
- [COHC Scope of Practice](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/about-the-training/ohc-scope-of-practice): COHC scope of practice including audiometric testing and professional standards.
- [COHC Certification and Training](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/about-the-training/ohc-training-and-certification): COHC certification requirements, training course details, and exam preparation.
- [COHC Recertification and Extension](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/about-the-training/ohc-recertification): COHC credential renewal and recertification extension requirements and process.
- [Find a Course](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/find-a-course): Course directory and search tool for COHC certification training programs.
- [OHC Renewal Extensions](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/find-a-course/ohc-renewal-extensions): OHC certification renewal and extension management through CAOHC account.

## Course Director Program

- [Course Director (CD)](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/course-director): Course Director certification program for COHC training instructors.
- [About Course Director](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/course-director/about-cd): Course Director overview covering roles, requirements, and professional standards.
- [CD Training and Certification](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/course-director/about-cd/cd-training-and-certification): Course Director certification requirements, eligibility, and professional qualifications.
- [CD Responsibilities](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/course-director/about-cd/cd-obligations): Course Director responsibilities, exam policies, and course administration requirements.
- [CD Directory](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/find-a-course/course-director-cd-listing): Course Director directory for finding approved COHC training instructors by region.

## Learning Platform & Exams

- [CAOHC Learning Center](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/lms-courses-and-exams): CAOHC Learning Center platform for course registration and certification exams.
- [COHC Exam Prep Tool](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/cohc-exam-prep-tool): COHC exam preparation tool with content outline and study resources.

## Training & Certifications Overview

- [Training and Certifications](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications): Overview of CAOHC certification programs including COHC, CD, CPS/A, and HCM.
- [CAOHC Homepage](https://www.caohc.org): CAOHC homepage introducing occupational hearing conservation certification and training programs.

## Resources & Support

- [Resources for the COHC](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/resources-for-the-ohc): COHC study resources, exam preparation materials, and credential verification tools.
- [COHC Online Credential Verification](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/ohc-online-credential-verification): Online credential lookup and verification tool for COHC certifications.
- [FAQ](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/faq): COHC certification FAQs covering OSHA compliance, audiometric testing, and training.

## Optional

- [Print Your Certificate](https://www.caohc.org/training-and-certifications/occupational-hearing-conservationist/print-your-certificate): Certificate printing and account management for CAOHC credential holders.
